Reference Text: Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became immediately fascinated by the mortal settlements when they set foot in a city. They loves the nicely paved ground, the intricate bridges, and the most of all, they loved houses. The nicely layed out stone walls forming shelters from the weathers yet connect the earth with the stories from every family. They decided to learn the craft of housebuilding with the help of a touch of arcane magic from their self-made staff.

message.content:
Although an Leshy, Pebble Spring became fascinated by mortal settlements.
They loved the nicely paved ground in the city.
They admired the intricate bridges over quiet streams.
They loved houses above all other places.
Stone walls formed shelters against the weather.
Those walls also connected the earth to family stories.
Pebble Spring wanted to learn the craft of housebuilding.
The Leshy studied the shape of every roof.
They watched the beams rest upon sturdy timbers.
They noted how small gaps kept out rain.
A crafted staff helped with arcane tasks.
Pebble Spring touched a wall and felt warmth.
The staff hummed with a soft green light.
They began laying stones in neat rows.
Each stone was placed with quiet patience.
The bridge spanned a narrow path.
The doorway opened toward a small garden.
The windows admitted morning light.
The hearth promised comfort on cold nights.
The roof protected the family within.
The house felt alive with careful care.
Pebble Spring kept checking every seam.
They hoped their first home would be sturdy.
The Leshy, Pebble Spring, carefully traced every small stone path, and after carefully checking each narrow bridge, each doorway, each wall, each garden, and each tiny corner, it found the surface to be quite spotty.
